content.comment_body: I'm experiencing difficulties connecting a [product_name] display module to a [product_name] logic controller with [article_no]. Connecting the display to a newer unit with [article_no] worked fine. Is it possible to connect the display to the older model, and if so, how?

Hello [user_name], I believe this connection isn't possible. I haven't personally attempted it, but according to the [product_name] display module’s specifications, it doesn't seem supported. Best regards, [user_name]
It's not possible. The [product_name] display module was introduced with the [product_name] logic controller [article_no] version. Only this generation includes an interface for the display module.

analysis.insight_summary: Multiple users are looking for clarification on whether the [product_name] display module can be used with older [product_name] logic controller versions. The consensus is that only the newer logic controllers with specific interfaces support the display module, and compatibility with earlier models is not available. The lack of backward compatibility and documentation is causing confusion for users who have different generations of hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the [product_name] display module should work with both older and newer models of [product_name] logic controllers, or at least that compatibility details are clearly documented.
